baseline_checkout: Windows Git checkout-index from the exact commit, core.autocrlf=true; all 179 solver .gd files are CRLF. Each normalized LF content was independently verified against its committed Git blob.
solver_identity_algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted res:// path UTF-8 bytes followed by exact file bytes for each .gd recursively in physics, sim, failures.
startup_context: Committed project, translations and selectively required committed presentation assets in isolated checkout; corresponding cached font/texture imports reused from the existing pinned Godot checkout. Those assets are outside the solver source hash.
